state:
- Nup98 is singled out without a packet-based or pre-registered reason to prefer it over other FG-nucleoporins. Fix: rank candidates by NPC-fraction phosphoproteomics ordered against cytoplasmic TDP-43 assemblies, and keep any single-gene claim provisional until that ranking exists.
- The three-arm test leaves both the induction of stress-granule-independent TDP-43 assemblies and the method of stress-granule suppression unspecified, so either manipulation can alter transport by itself. Fix: lock induction to a defined de-mixing system and include an arm in which stress-granule suppression alone leaves NLS-reporter import unchanged.
- Phospho-null and phospho-mimetic alleles depend on unmapped sites, and the falsifier list omits failure to detect assembly-linked Nup98 phosphorylation during import failure. Fix: prespecify site inclusion by NPC localization, stoichiometry, and precedence before death markers, and count absence of those sites as falsification.
